faqs.question: When is Propose Day 2027?
faqs.answer: Propose Day 2027 is Monday 8 February. It is the second day of Valentine week, which opens with Rose Day on Sunday 7 February and ends with Valentine’s Day on Sunday 14 February 2027.

faqs.question: Is Propose Day on 7 or 8 February?
faqs.answer: 8 February. A page that labels 7 February as Propose Day is describing Rose Day, which is the first day of the week. The two sit next to each other, so check the date before you schedule anything.

faqs.question: Should I use tum or aap in a Propose Day message?
faqs.answer: Use तुम if you already speak to each other daily as equals, and आप if you have not yet moved to तुम. Hindi marks deference through a three-tier तू / तुम / आप system, so the pronoun carries as much meaning as the sentence does.

faqs.question: Can I type the quote in Roman Hindi instead of Devanagari?
faqs.answer: Yes, and most people do — the phone keyboard decides it. Every line on this page has a Roman transliteration for that reason. Send the Devanagari if you want it to look considered, the Roman if you want it to read like you talking.

faqs.question: What changes if I am proposing to a boy?
faqs.answer: The verb endings. Flip रहोगी to रहोगे, रहेगी to रहेगा, and रहा हूँ to रही हूँ for a female speaker. The nouns and the register stay exactly as they are.

faqs.question: Is it rude to use tu in a propose day message?
faqs.answer: It depends entirely on where you both are from. तू reads as intimacy across much of north-western India and as an insult in a lot of the rest of it. If तू is not already the pronoun between you, do not introduce it on the day you are asking.

faqs.question: What is the difference between propose day quotes and shayari?
faqs.answer: A quote is a plain statement in spoken Hindi; shayari leans on Urdu-derived vocabulary — इश्क़, दुआ, ख़त्म — and usually on rhythm. Send shayari only if the person actually enjoys reading it, or it lands as performance.

faqs.question: Does sending a forwarded quote actually count?
faqs.answer: It counts as remembering the date, which is real. It just does not signal much beyond that, because forwarding takes no effort. Editing one clause so the line could only have come from you is the smallest possible upgrade.

faqs.question: What should I send if I think the answer might be no?
faqs.answer: Something that leaves the friendship intact and does not demand an immediate answer. Two of the lines on this page are written for exactly that — they ask, then explicitly give the person time.

faqs.question: Is proposing over WhatsApp worse than in person?
faqs.answer: Usually, yes, if in person is genuinely available. Propose Day 2027 falls on a working Monday, so for a lot of people it is not. A message you wrote yourself beats a rushed in-person ask you did not think about.

faqs.question: How long should a Propose Day message in Hindi be?
faqs.answer: One or two sentences. Every line on this page fits in a single message bubble on a phone, which matters because 48.9% of SubhSandesh page views are on a phone, platform-wide (25,167 of 51,504).

faqs.question: Which SubhSandesh page suits a Propose Day message?
faqs.answer: The proposal scrapbook if it is genuinely a marriage proposal, and the ‘I love you’ page if it is not — that template is the most-built on the platform, 1,138 pages and 24.9% of everything created. Most Propose Day asks are the second kind.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Propose Day Quotes in Hindi, Grouped by Who You Are Asking

Propose day quotes in Hindi only work when the register matches the person: तुम for someone you talk to daily, आप for someone you have not switched to तुम with, तू only if it is already the pronoun between you. Below are 16 lines in Devanagari, each with a Roman transliteration and an English gloss, grouped by register and situation, and dated to Propose Day 2027 — **Monday 8 February**, the second day of Valentine week. Every SubhSandesh number here is platform-wide across 16 page types — 4,567 pages built since 12 March 2026, 39.9% password-protected before sharing (1,822 of 4,567) — or sampled on /love-gf, and the sentence says which.

## What a Propose Day line in Hindi has to get right

A Propose Day quote in Hindi is a short line, one or two sentences, sent on 8 February to ask someone to be with you. It is read in Devanagari and usually typed in Roman letters on a phone.

What decides whether it lands is the second-person pronoun. Hindi has no single "you": Hadavizadeh and Singh's 2022 study of politeness describes [a three-tier deference system of तू / तुम / आप](http://scf-lsa.info/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/2-Ali-HADAVIZADEH-Rajdeep-SINGH-16-29.pdf), where तुम marks a familiar-but-polite relationship between status equals and आप marks deference to someone of higher or unestablished standing.

Get that wrong and the content stops mattering. An आप line to a girlfriend of three years reads like a wedding card; a तू line to a near-stranger reads like rudeness.

## Propose Day 2027 is Monday 8 February, not 7 February

Valentine week 2027 opens with Rose Day on Sunday 7 February. Propose Day is the **second** day, Monday 8 February 2027; the week ends with Valentine's Day on Sunday 14 February 2027.

Propose Day 2026 fell on a Sunday. In 2027 it is a working Monday, so an in-person ask has to survive an office day, and most sending lands on a phone late in the evening.

A list headed "7 Feb Propose Day" is naming Rose Day, not Propose Day. Check the weekday on anything you copy — a wrong date is the error a reader catches instantly.

## 16 Propose Day lines in Hindi, grouped by register and situation

Verb endings are written for a male speaker addressing a woman. Flip **रहोगी → रहोगे**, **रहेगी → रहेगा**, **रहा हूँ → रही हूँ** to reverse either side.

### 1. तुम register — plain spoken, for someone you talk to daily

> तुम्हारे बिना दिन शुरू ही नहीं होता। मेरे साथ रहोगी?
> *Tumhaare bina din shuru hi nahin hota. Mere saath rahogi?*
> "The day doesn't begin without you. Will you stay with me?"

> मैंने बहुत सोचा, और हर बार जवाब तुम ही निकले।
> *Maine bahut socha, aur har baar jawaab tum hi nikle.*
> "I thought hard, and every time the answer turned out to be you."

> मुझे बड़े वादे नहीं आते। बस तुम्हारे साथ रहना है।
> *Mujhe bade vaade nahin aate. Bas tumhaare saath rehna hai.*
> "I'm no good at big promises. I just want to be with you."

### 2. आप register — respectful, before you switch to तुम

> आपसे कुछ कहना है, और आज से अच्छा दिन नहीं मिलेगा।
> *Aapse kuchh kehna hai, aur aaj se achchha din nahin milega.*
> "Something I want to tell you, and no better day than today."

> जवाब जल्दी में मत दीजिए। बस इतना जान लीजिए कि मैं गंभीर हूँ।
> *Jawaab jaldi mein mat deejiye. Bas itna jaan leejiye ki main gambhir hoon.*
> "Don't answer in a hurry. Just know that I am serious."

> घरवालों से बात करने से पहले आपसे पूछना ज़रूरी लगा।
> *Gharwaalon se baat karne se pehle aapse poochhna zaroori laga.*
> "Before I speak to the families, it felt right to ask you."

### 3. Urdu-leaning shayari diction

> दिल की बात कहने में उम्र लग गई — तुम्हीं से शुरू, तुम्हीं पे ख़त्म।
> *Dil ki baat kehne mein umr lag gayi — tumhin se shuru, tumhin pe khatm.*
> "It took a lifetime to say it: begins with you, ends with you."

> तुम्हें देखा तो लगा कि दुआ क़बूल हो गई।
> *Tumhein dekha to laga ki duaa qabool ho gayi.*
> "Seeing you felt like a prayer being answered."

> इश्क़ का दावा नहीं करता, निभाने का इरादा रखता हूँ।
> *Ishq ka daawa nahin karta, nibhaane ka iraada rakhta hoon.*
> "I make no claims about love. I intend to see it through."

### 4. तू register — only if you already speak this way

तू is affection across much of north-western India and an insult almost everywhere else. Use these only if तू is already the pronoun between you.

> तू है तो सब ठीक लगता है। हमेशा रहेगी न?
> *Tu hai to sab theek lagta hai. Hamesha rahegi na?*
> "With you around everything feels alright. You'll stay, won't you?"

> तेरे बिना का प्लान मैंने बनाया ही नहीं।
> *Tere bina ka plan maine banaaya hi nahin.*
> "I never made a plan that didn't have you in it."

### 5. Asking over text, or across distance

> ये मैसेज दस बार लिखा और मिटाया। ग्यारहवीं बार भेज रहा हूँ।
> *Ye message das baar likha aur mitaaya. Gyaarahvin baar bhej raha hoon.*
> "I wrote and deleted this ten times. This is the eleventh."

> फ़ोन पर कहना कमज़ोरी नहीं है — बस और इंतज़ार नहीं होता।
> *Phone par kehna kamzori nahin hai — bas aur intezaar nahin hota.*
> "Saying it by phone isn't a cop-out. I can't wait longer."

> चाहता हूँ कि अगली बार मिलें, तो ये बात पहले से कही हुई हो।
> *Chaahta hoon ki agli baar milen, to ye baat pehle se kahi hui ho.*
> "I want this already said by the time we meet next."

### 6. When the answer might be no

> जवाब जो भी हो, इज़्ज़त वही रहेगी। पूछना ज़रूरी था।
> *Jawaab jo bhi ho, izzat wahi rahegi. Poochhna zaroori tha.*
> "Whatever the answer, my respect stays the same. I needed to ask."

> सोचने का वक़्त लो। सवाल दबाकर रखना मुश्किल था।
> *Sochne ka waqt lo. Sawaal dabaakar rakhna mushkil tha.*
> "Take your time. Sitting on the question was the hard part."

Every line above was written for this page. Eleven more were drafted and dropped: seven I could not verify or that ran close to film lyrics, four for length.

## Which way of sending costs you what, and what the reader can tell

The right-hand column carries SubhSandesh figures, platform-wide or sampled on /love-gf. None is specific to proposals.

| How you send it | Elapsed time | What reads as yours | SubhSandesh figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Forwarded broadcast image | under a minute | nothing | — |
| A line from this page, as-is | 1–2 minutes | the register | — |
| That line, edited to carry a detail only you two know | 5–10 minutes | the detail | 48.9% of views are on a phone, platform-wide (25,167 of 51,504) |
| A page built around the ask | median 6.4 hours, first save to last edit | all of it | sampled on /love-gf, n=1,138; 39.9% password-protect before sharing, platform-wide |

The 6.4 hours is an elapsed window, not time at the keyboard — people start a page, put the phone down, come back. It is the closest measure of how long this writing sits with someone.

## Why a forwarded line lands differently from one you wrote

A forwarded quote is a real social act, not a fraud. It is simply cheap, and cheapness shows.

Forwarding is the default mode of Indian group messaging. Garimella and colleagues' 2024 study of a rural Indian village [classified 604 'forwarded many times' items out of 53,389 messages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.08172v1) over two months, and found entertainment, religion, satire and "good morning" messages made up over a third of what went viral.

Cost is the point of a signal. In Seymour and Sozou's model in [Journal of Theoretical Biology, January 2009](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/15012/1/15012.pdf), extended courtship signals because it is expensive: a "good" male courts for longer than a "bad" one, and even a gift worthless to the receiver can signal, because the cost sits with the giver.

That is a model of animal courtship, not WhatsApp; I borrow the logic, not the result. A copied line takes no effort, so it signals nothing beyond having remembered the date.

The recipient also has to notice. Maslowska, Smit and van den Putte's 2016 Journal of Interactive Advertising study reports that [perceived personalisation mediates a personalised message's effect](https://dare.uva.nl/personal/pure/en/publications/it-is-all-in-the-name-a-study-of-consumers-responses-to-personalized-communication%28bc67108a-c80b-4a12-8d76-c8be96953726%29.html) on attention and attitude, with stronger effects when the receiver notices the personalisation. Only the abstract was readable.

Attribution changes how identical words read. In a 2024 PNAS experiment, recipients [felt less heard once they believed a reply came from AI](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10998586/) rather than a person — though undisclosed AI replies scored better at making people feel heard.

So take a line above and change one clause so it could only have come from you. If you want the ask to be the artefact rather than one message in a thread, the [Will You Marry Me? proposal scrapbook](/proposal) is built for that: your story, ending in a YES button that grows every time they dodge it.

## When a proposal page is the wrong choice on Propose Day

Most Propose Day traffic is not a marriage proposal, and treating it as one is this category's failure mode. If you are asking someone to be your girlfriend, a scrapbook ending in "Will you marry me?" overshoots enough to be embarrassing.

For that ask the [romantic 'I love you' page](/love-gf) is the honest fit — the most-built template here, 1,138 pages, 24.9% of everything created platform-wide. To just ask someone out, [The Invitation](/date-invitation) is the smaller version.

Sometimes none of it is right. If you can say it in person that Monday evening, do — and with 48.9% of views on a phone, platform-wide, your careful page is most likely read while someone walks somewhere.

## Sources

- Hadavizadeh and Singh, "Leech's Politeness Maxims in Hindi and Persian", 2022 — [PDF](http://scf-lsa.info/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/2-Ali-HADAVIZADEH-Rajdeep-SINGH-16-29.pdf)
- Garimella et al., "Deciphering Viral Trends in WhatsApp", 28 June 2024 — [arXiv:2407.08172v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.08172v1)
- Seymour and Sozou, "Duration of courtship effort as a costly signal", J. Theoretical Biology 256(1), January 2009 — [author copy](https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/15012/1/15012.pdf)
- Maslowska, Smit and van den Putte, "It Is All in the Name", Journal of Interactive Advertising 16(1), 2016 — [abstract](https://dare.uva.nl/personal/pure/en/publications/it-is-all-in-the-name-a-study-of-consumers-responses-to-personalized-communication%28bc67108a-c80b-4a12-8d76-c8be96953726%29.html)
- Yin, Jia and Wakslak, "AI can help people feel heard, but an AI label diminishes this impact", PNAS, 29 March 2024 — [text](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10998586/)

A बहार / इज़हार rhyming couplet — the rhyme forced unnatural word order and the phrasing reads like a stock forward.
A आँखों के समंदर line and one other that ran close to film lyrics — I could not confirm they were not lifted.
A ता-उम्र line: correct, but I could not vouch that it reads as natural spoken Hindi in a message.
A तू-register line framed as possession (तू मेरी है) — wrong thing to publish on a page about asking.
One line that mixed आप and तुम inside a single sentence — a register break.
Four further correct lines were cut only to keep the body inside the 1,500–1,800 word budget.

failed.item: No source passes the **swap test** — none could sit unchanged in a different keyword's post in this batch
failed.why: Still fails, and for a wider reason than first recorded. This batch contains four other Hindi-targeting posts — how-to-propose-girlfriend-in-hindi, propose-message-in-hindi, propose-day-wishes-in-hindi and propose-girlfriend-shayari — so the Hadavizadeh and Singh politeness study, which is about the तू / तुम / आप system rather than about proposing, could sit unchanged in any of them. (It could not sit in the Marathi, Bengali or English posts: those are different pronoun systems.) It stays because the register claim is the page's organising spine and no substitute was fetched. Closes only when a source specific to Hindi romantic or courtship register, rather than Hindi politeness generally, is found and fetched — re-check when WebSearch budget resets, since Crossref and Europe PMC returned nothing on that phrase.

auditReport.honestAssessment: This SERP is a February news cycle owned by MensXP, Zee, Asianet, Webdunia and gifting retailers whose domain authority is far above ours, and several refresh the same page every year. Target is position 6–10, not 3, and the fix pass did not change that. What this page has that the pages analysed do not: register grouping with a Roman transliteration and an English gloss on every line, verb-flip instructions, and a correctly dated Monday 8 February 2027 with Rose Day named as the 7 February it is routinely confused with — plus five fetched third-party sources where those pages cite none. That is a real citation case for an answer engine and a weak one for Google rank, because none of it substitutes for links. Two claims about what incumbents publish were removed in remediation: there is no measured Hindi SERP in the inherited Phase 1 data, so the page now argues the date from the calendar rather than from anyone else's headline.
